sections.title: Technical Communication and Academic Wrting for Non-native Speakers of English
sections.description: EAS 510 is a writing course designed for graduate students at both the master's and Ph.D. levels. The features of academic writing used in American universities will be explored by analyzing sample texts, papers in various academic disciplines, and the students' own writing. A variety of rhetorical patterns will be practiced. Attention will be paid to organization, development of ideas, clarity, coherence, style, grammar, and mechanics. Instructor permission required for undergraduates.

sections.title: Technical Communication and Academic Wrting for Non-native Speakers of English
sections.description: EAS 5100 is a communication course designed for international graduate students who come from a non-native English-speaking background. EAS 5100 provides instruction and practice for spoken and written communication skills. Specifically, the features of academic prose for research writing, and those of American pronunciation for fluency and presentations will be addressed. Assignments will include technical papers and in-class presentations that focus on engineering topics.
